title.zh: 圆周角 · 为什么恰好是一半

desc.zh: 圆上一点看一条弧，张角永远是圆心看它的恰好一半——拖着点满圆跑都变不了。连一条半径，两个等腰三角形把这一半算得明明白白；弧过半圈，张角正好是直角。
desc.en: From any point on the circle, an arc subtends exactly half the angle it subtends at the centre — drag the point all the way round and it never changes. One extra radius splits the proof into two isosceles triangles; and once the arc passes a semicircle, the angle is exactly a right angle.
